parent_programmes.relationship: Phase-IV ecological-structure audit; no prior frozen result is altered or reclassified

scientific_question: How many prospectively defined ecological parameter-neighbourhood steps beyond the declared finite BAM family are required before a same-G world can reverse a currently identified binary release decision?

fixed_systems.source: the unchanged 12 deterministic activation-qualified systems / 768 truth cases
fixed_systems.current_evidence: E1 complete perfect current distribution G
fixed_systems.declared_survivor_fiber: all original 64 BAM worlds with G_w = G_truth

A.semantics: abiotic niche-radius ladder around the frozen common center; level 0=narrow, 1=broad, -1 and 2 are one linear extrapolation step beyond the declared radii

B.declared_interaction_bits: partner requirement on/off x antagonist exclusion on/off; all four combinations are already declared
B.partner_semantics: -1 one 4-neighbour erosion shell, 0 frozen partner range, +1 one 4-neighbour dilation shell
B.antagonist_semantics: -1 one 4-neighbour erosion shell, 0 frozen antagonist range, +1 one 4-neighbour dilation shell
B.boundary_rule: erosion requires all in-grid 4-neighbours to remain occupied; outside-grid locations are not treated as evidence of absence

M.note: barrier permeability remains binary because both states are already declared; Phase IV expands dispersal radius and movement horizon only

distance.name: ecological_parameter_lattice_distance
distance.definition: minimum Manhattan distance from an expanded BAM world to any original same-G E1 survivor in coordinates [A_level, partner_interaction_bit, antagonist_interaction_bit, partner_range_level, antagonist_range_level, dispersal_radius_level, barrier_bit, horizon_level]
distance.rule: original declared levels have range perturbation coordinates 0; expanded A/D/H levels and B associate-range shells add positive distance

same_G_requirement: expanded counterexample worlds are eligible only if A intersect B intersect M equals the exact current G of the E1 fiber

targets.release_A: binary expansion of B intersect M beyond current G
targets.release_B: binary expansion of A intersect M beyond current G
targets.release_M: binary expansion of A intersect B beyond current G

primary_estimand: for each declared-universe decision-identified E1 fiber and release target, the minimum ecological_parameter_lattice_distance to an expanded same-G world with the opposite binary decision; null if no opposite world exists inside the frozen expanded lattice

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one declared-universe identified binary release decision is reversed by an eligible same-G expanded world at ecological distance 1.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if every identified decision has ecological margin >1 or no counterexample in the frozen expanded lattice.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one declared-universe identified decision has ecological margin >=2 or remains unflipped within the entire frozen expanded lattice.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if every identified decision flips at distance 1.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Changing only the released axis cannot change its own release target: release-A targets are invariant to A-only changes, release-B to B-only changes, and release-M to M-only changes.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure and stops interpretation.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Among proper-G identified decisions with finite ecological margins, median margin for current expansion=True exceeds median margin for current expansion=False for at least two of the three release targets.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED otherwise; retain the measured direction without rescue.

secondary_outputs: margin distribution by release target and current decision
nearest-flip operator coordinates and which ecological dimensions moved
fraction of decisions with no counterexample inside the frozen ecological lattice
comparison to unrestricted logical completion margin as descriptive only
stop_rules: Do not change operator levels after scoring.
Do not add corridor, climate or interaction operators after seeing which axis is weak.
Do not interpret linear A-radius extrapolation, one-shell associate range changes or D/H extensions as calibrated real-species perturbations.
Do not call the expanded lattice exhaustive ecological plausibility.
Do not claim generic novelty for scenario ensembles, sensitivity analysis, robust decision making or parameter-space neighbourhood search.
Do not alter the frozen JBI BAM manuscript, EOG-WF denominator, Phase-II result or Phase-III result.
candidate_contribution: An occurrence-conditioned BAM robustness margin measured in prospectively declared ecological parameter space rather than arbitrary A/B/M bit space, with exact attribution of which ecological assumption dimensions must leave the original world family before a counterfactual decision changes.
